# taped

> Python's serene audio accessor


## Pages in this subsection

- [taped](taped.html.md): Simple audio acquisition
- [taped.base](taped.base.html.md): Base of taped objects
- [taped.display](taped.display.html.md): Display utilities for audio waveforms.
- [taped.tools](taped.tools.html.md): Recording and playback tools for audio data.
- [taped.util](taped.util.html.md): Utilities for audio processing and streaming in the taped package.
